purpose: Engineer-supplied current local environment for the actual candidate package. Replace placeholders from its final binding and fresh observations; this template is not a connection or permission grant.
creo: <licensed Creo root containing Common Files and Parametric>
java: <legal declared JDK root containing bin/java.exe; verified host JDK25.0.3, target17 is not Java17 qualification>
installation: <source-verified component directory for the actual candidate; JAR/DLL are separate from the EXE>

environment_variables.CREO_CLI_SERVICE_TOKEN_FILE: <declared local credential file; contents are never printed>

creo-cli-service.jar.sha256: <actual candidate manifest JAR SHA-256; verify the installed file>

creo_cli_sketch.dll.sha256: <actual candidate manifest DLL SHA-256; verify the installed file>

optional_frozen_STEP_investigation: Not required by the first-trial core or EXE client. Only for a separately authorized STEP investigation, supply an actual Python/OCP interpreter/module binding and an explicitly supplied consumer. Missing Python/OCP does not fail core environment discovery.
rules: Only the task owner can authorize write permission and scope. The template grants neither. No separate Python or Node installation is needed by the single-EXE client; supplied scripts require PowerShell 7.4 or later.
Read component_files from the final package binding, then verify actual installed bytes. Never reuse R5 or another historical JAR hash just because a template listed it.
Fill runtime_pin only from a fresh public process-only context observation checked against the owned startup and actual component sources.
A successful process-only check proves neither CAD idle nor getter completion nor recovery of an old operation.
Do not change history directories, aliases, ports or Clients to bypass unresolved operations.
